why: A ready shape loaded from a file runs its base constructors, so it has pixel snapping and a reference list like a newly drawn one. In the view renders of shapes-ready.gvdesign the loaded ready shapes are snapped to whole pixels; every differing pixel lies within 2 px of a shape edge of the old render. In engine-model/nodes/defaults-constructed a ready shape built without a processor now has the base defaults (the same values as a constructed rectangle for every shared property) instead of undefined. The preview, bitmap and exports don't snap and need nothing.
